queries.query: Madiun Indonesia official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry BPN ATR
queries.result: Official ATR/BPN BHUMI documentation describes a public interactive land-information map with bidang tanah (parcel) layers and searches by NIB, HAK or NIBEL. The official Kantor Pertanahan Kota Madiun site confirms the local land-office custodian. No safe anonymous machine-readable Madiun parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified.

queries.query: Madiun peta bidang tanah kadaster resmi ATR BPN Kantor Pertanahan Kota Madiun
queries.result: Sumber resmi berbahasa Indonesia mengidentifikasi BHUMI ATR/BPN sebagai peta interaktif yang menyajikan informasi spasial bidang tanah, serta Kantor Pertanahan Kota Madiun sebagai pelaksana urusan pengukuran dan pemetaan kadastral. Portal SmartMap Kota Madiun is described as a PBB/P2 tax map with BPN land-price basemap, not an open cadastral parcel-vector service. No safe anonymous parcel geometry response was verified.

registry.custodian: Kantor Pertanahan Kota Madiun, Kementerian Agraria dan Tata Ruang/Badan Pertanahan Nasional (ATR/BPN)
registry.sourceScope: Local land-office evidence covers cadastral measurement and mapping activity in Kota Madiun; BHUMI is the national ATR/BPN public spatial-information viewer.
registry.geometryAccess: BHUMI is publicly documented, but the reviewed anonymous route did not expose a verified safe parcel feature response. No login, credentials, private token, owner, address, titleholder or tax fields were requested.

geometry.exactWupPointTest: The exact WUP point was preserved but not treated as an absence test; no parcel hit or miss was used as evidence of citywide coverage.

runtimeReadiness.reason: A real local registry custodian and public viewer documentation were verified, but no bounded anonymous response containing a stable native parcel identity plus geometry was obtained and no adapter was independently qualified.
